prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: wrist fracture. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1083; do not mention it.)
text:
We are writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was travelling in the right-hand lane when your insured, while changing lanes, moved into our client's vehicle, sideswiping it and forcing it toward the shoulder. The police report and the damage to both vehicles confirm that your insured failed to check for traffic before merging and is solely responsible for the collision.

As a direct result of the impact, our client sustained a fracture of the left wrist. He was transported from the scene for emergency treatment, required surgical reduction and the placement of a plate and screws, and has been advised that he will need physical therapy for several months. He has missed substantial time from work and continues to experience pain, reduced grip strength, and limited range of motion.

Our client has documented his medical expenses, lost wages, vehicle damage, and the impact these injuries have had on his daily life. Based on this evidence, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this collision.

This demand will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice and seek all damages available under the law.
